prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier and adding targeted sign-in hints won, whereas placing sign-in late after adoption certificates severely hurt conversion.
Focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) won, while multi-step setup flows consistently degraded conversion.
Select layout redesigns (Pick Friend stage/carousel, Choose Path grid/carousel, Story scroll/stage, Home Intro checklist) won, whereas photo upload redesigns and waiting screen spotlight redesigns hurt conversion.
Desktop activity/interaction hints and waiting screen system notes won, whereas standalone headline updates, audio cues, progress bars, and tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for major winning features, forecasting negative or minimal gains for changes that yielded large positive conversion lifts.
Predictions were too high for non-winning or failing changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right before Home Intro showing users how to drag, click, hide, and summon their pet. (why: Support mail showed multiple post-onboarding complaints where users were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once created.)
1: [adoption, redesign] List Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Replaces the layout of the Pick Friend screen with a clear list structure detailing companion traits side-by-side. (why: Adoption has an 86.4% step conversion with high median time (89s), indicating users struggle to evaluate companion options cleanly.)
2: [home, redesign] List Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen: Rebuilds the waiting screen using a clean vertical list layout summarizing active background loading steps. (why: The waiting screen in the home step has a high mean duration (2336s) and causes user drop-off due to poor status clarity.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Multi Account Cloud Sync Headline: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in prevents pet loss when reinstalling or changing devices. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets where users reported missing pets after re-authenticating on different devices or accounts.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Tray Quick Hint: Adds a hint on the Home Intro screen pointing out the desktop system tray icon for quick pet visibility toggle. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding regarding how to hide or reveal the pet when working in full screen.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Tray Background Hint: Adds clear background status information explaining that desktop system tray integration is being configured. (why: Reduces anxiety during long generation wait times and prepares users for where desktop features will reside.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Launcher Setup Flow Before Finish: Introduces a launcher configuration step at the end of onboarding to ensure desktop permissions and app opening behavior are correct. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop or the desktop app failing to open after completing setup.)
7: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Preservation Note: Adds a hint on the Adoption Certificate screen reassuring users that their adoption certificate is saved to their active account. (why: Strengthens confidence before the generation phase and addresses support complaints regarding pet reset issues.)
